description: Nine envelope generators sharing one drawable editor, each timed from the patched clock and each with its own trigger and hold input

params.text: Sets how far the points either side of a dragged point follow it, the pull falling to under two thirds at each step away; at zero only the dragged point moves

inputs.text: A rising edge here restarts every envelope at the start of its shape
The clock every envelope is timed from, one edge to the next setting the length of a beat; with nothing patched here no channel produces an envelope
A rising edge here retriggers all nine envelopes at once
Held above 2.5V this freezes that channel's envelope at its current value
A rising edge here retriggers that channel's envelope from the start of its shape

outputs.text: That channel's envelope, over the range picked by the Out Range switch: 0-5V, -5V to 5V, 0-10V or -10V to 10V

notes: nothing comes out until a clock is patched to Beat; with that jack empty the whole module is skipped
every channel comes up with its shape flat along the bottom, so draw one in the display, or step through the built-in shapes with the Presets arrows, before patching an output
the Channel row picks which of the nine envelopes the display shows and edits
with Draw off, dragging a point moves that one point, and the Rubber Band knob pulls its neighbours with it; with Draw on, dragging across the display sets every point the pointer crosses
right-clicking a point in the display returns it to the middle of the range
holding Control while dragging a point moves it in much finer steps
Envelope Mode sets what the shape does at its end: Loop, Reverse Loop, Ping Pong, One Shot or Two Shot (Fwd-Rev)
Time/Div sets how long one pass of the shape takes against the patched clock: 64th, 32nd, 16th, 8th, 4tr or 1 Bar
Gate View holds each point as a level for its whole division instead of drawing a line from one point to the next
Invert turns the shown channel's shape upside down, Smooth rounds it off, and Rand replaces every point with a random one
Copy, then a click on another Channel button, gives that channel this one's shape, Time/Div, Envelope Mode, Out Range and Gate View setting
